name: Jeanne
source:
Her mature demeanor gives the impression she may be an older sister or some other relative of hers. The image of her in battle invokes that of the tragic heroine Jeanne d'Arc, but her cold gaze is constantly thick with hatred, chillingly murderous intent seeping from her every gesture.

Never lending an ear to the denizens of the distorted world's cries for salvation, she spends her every waking moment hunting down and fighting invading forces. Wielding the tainted demonic blade Joyeuse, she brings anyone who meets that blade to destruction, no matter who they may be. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1230]MangaGamer[/url]]
